items.t: Ladner is one of Delta's three communities, on the Fraser River's south bank; Ladner and Tsawwassen together are South Delta.
Ladner Village, the historic core, sits west of Chilukthan Slough.
Detached zones set minimum subdivision lot areas from 335 square metres (m²) in RS7 to 550 m² in RS5.
Duplex zones need more land: RD1 requires 836 m², RD4 requires 504 m².

items.t: Delta Hospital, 5800 Mountain View Boulevard, gives Ladner a 24/7 emergency department.
Ladner Elementary is dual-track English and French Immersion, Kindergarten to Grade 7.
Ladner Leisure Centre, 4600 Clarence Taylor Crescent, is Ladner's main indoor recreation facility.

items.t: 6073 44A Avenue: Bylaw No. 8373 would split a 1,726 m² lot into three single detached lots, flood-proofing covenant required. Status: readings stage, January 2024.
Ladner Village Revitalization includes the Chisholm Street Wharf; feedback on Chisholm Street Upgrades was sought in February 2026. Status: engagement summarized (as of November 3, 2026).
Heritage houses: the Heritage Conservation Fund policy (November 2025) ties help to the heritage levy in Bylaw No. 8386, 2024, and heritage work must follow Schedule 7493-1 of Bylaw No. 7493, 2017.
Route 601 is Ladner's main bus: South Delta to Bridgeport Station (Canada Line), stopping at Ladner Exchange, via Ladner Trunk Road, Highway 17A and Highway 99.

Ladner houses: what sold, November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026

117 houses sold in Ladner with a median price of $1,340,000 (the middle half sold between $1,150,000 and $1,550,000), taking a median of 16 days to sell at 96.8% of the last list price; 10% sold above list. They had a median $585 per square foot, a median year built of 1986 and a median lot of 6,008 square feet.
